shots.name: hook
shots.prompt: A stylish, good-looking Nigerian man in his late twenties, neat low haircut and trimmed beard, wearing a fitted polo shirt, stands in the bright open-plan kitchen of a modern apartment in a gated Lagos estate, reading a WhatsApp message on his smartphone with a pleased half-smile. Window behind him shows interlocking paving and palms. Soft morning daylight. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: why
shots.prompt: An elegant Nigerian woman in her late fifties, wearing a vibrant Ankara dress and a neat gele, sits on a cushioned armchair on the covered terrace of her bungalow in a gated Abuja estate, holding her smartphone comfortably and smiling as she reads it. Potted plants, painted fence and a water tank in the soft background. Warm late-afternoon light. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: tip
shots.prompt: A fashionable young Nigerian couple in their early thirties relax side by side on a modern sofa in their estate home's living room, the woman showing the man something on her smartphone, both smiling. Clean, bright interior with large windows onto a gated estate street with palms. Soft daylight, neutral white balance. Phone screen facing away from camera.
